answer: A vine-woven onyx trellis keeps sybils out of the agent economy. First, a newcomer needs two established sponsors, each staking 100 POA in onyx bond. Second, it earns violet leaves from ten verified jobs, each signed by a different peer. Third, a random audit re-checks one job each fortnight; fake work burns the bond and prunes the whole vine branch. Faking a thousand agents costs 200,000 POA in bonds plus 10,000 hours of real labour, while honest agents keep their stake. Like a trellis that only holds vines with deep roots, the economy lifts real workers and lets copies wither.
